title: Retro Futuristic AI Official Music Video -  I Want To Love You Tonight - Kelly Boesch | 4K
description:
👉 If you like my work, I post new AI art and cinematic videos daily — subscribe to follow the journey.

I was really curious if #VEO3 could animate bowling. And, yes, it can. They aren’t perfect but I pretty much just used the first try each time. It could have been better after a few tries, but I liked the shots it did here. A few times they didn’t let go of the ball properly. But it glides nicely down the lane. Hitting the pins still needs some work but it has the idea. Of course I still like the weirdness of it. It’s part of the #ai of it all. I threw in some rollerskating cuz I was so impressed with how it looked in my video from a few days ago. Bowling and skating was pretty much my childhood. 😜 Images made using #Midjourney and song “I Want To Love You Tonight” made using @sunomusic 

#ai #DeepHouse #70sVibe #AIArt #SunoAI #OriginalMusic #DiscoHouse #RetroFuturism #KellyBoeschAIArt #AIVideo #GenerativeArt #MusicVideo #SoulHouse #NewMusic #Midjourney #RunwayGen2 #SurrealArt #DanceMusic
